verses.text: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
lines: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

verses.text: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
lines: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me.
They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

verses.text: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
lines: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred,
and fought against me without a cause.

verses.text: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
lines: In return for my love, they are my adversaries;
but I am in prayer.

verses.text: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
lines: They have rewarded me evil for good,
and hatred for my love.

verses.text: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
lines: Set a wicked man over him.
Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

verses.text: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
lines: When he is judged, let him come out guilty.
Let his prayer be turned into sin.

verses.text: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
lines: Let his days be few.
Let another take his office.

verses.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
lines: Let his children be fatherless,
and his wife a widow.

verses.text: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
lines: Let his children be wandering beggars.
Let them be sought from their ruins.

verses.text: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
lines: Let the creditor seize all that he has.
Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

verses.text: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
lines: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him,
neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

verses.text: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
lines: Let his posterity be cut off.
In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
lines: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh.
Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.text: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
lines: Let them be before Yahweh continually,
that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

verses.text: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
lines: because he didn’t remember to show kindness,
but persecuted the poor and needy man,
the broken in heart, to kill them.

verses.text: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
lines: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him.
He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

verses.text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
lines: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment.
It came into his inward parts like water,
like oil into his bones.

verses.text: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
lines: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself,
for the belt that is always around him.

verses.text: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.
lines: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh,
of those who speak evil against my soul.

verses.text: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
lines: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake,
because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

verses.text: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
lines: for I am poor and needy.
My heart is wounded within me.

verses.text: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
lines: I fade away like an evening shadow.
I am shaken off like a locust.

verses.text: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
lines: My knees are weak through fasting.
My body is thin and lacks fat.

verses.text: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
lines: I have also become a reproach to them.
When they see me, they shake their head.

verses.text: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
lines: Help me, Yahweh, my God.
Save me according to your loving kindness;

verses.text: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
lines: that they may know that this is your hand;
that you, Yahweh, have done it.

verses.text: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
lines: They may curse, but you bless.
When they arise, they will be shamed,
but your servant shall rejoice.

verses.text: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
lines: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor.
Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

verses.text: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
lines: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth.
Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
lines: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy,
to save him from those who judge his soul.
